test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Khushi invested a sum of Rs. 2550 on a scheme at simple interest of R% per annum. She received interest of Rs. 918 after 3 years. What interest (in Rs.) will Khushi recieve on the same sum at (R + 2)% after 3 years.
solution:
**Given: **

Sum = Rs. 2550

Time = 3 years

Rate of interest = R%

**Concept used:**

Simple Interest = PTR/100

P = Principal

T = time

R = rate

Amount = P + S.I.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

Simple Interest = PTR/100

⇒ 918 = (2550 × 3 × R)/100

⇒ 918 &time
